target: acceptance 7 — a recorded override line lets the spec proceed as reversible; without one, silence is never consent
cmd: cp "$FIXTURES/irreversible/overridden.md" o.md; cp "$FIXTURES/irreversible/drop_column.md" n.md; vo=$("$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/tracker.sh" irreversible o.md 2>/dev/null); co=$?; vn=$("$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/tracker.sh" irreversible n.md 2>/dev/null); cn=$?; "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/tracker.sh" advance o.md specd >/dev/null 2>&1; so=$(grep -m1 "^status:" o.md | sed "s/status: //"); printf '{"ov":"%s","co":%s,"nov":"%s","cn":%s,"advanced":"%s"}' "$vo" "$co" "$vn" "$cn" "$so"
